learning_outcomes.text: Explain the purpose and scope of financial due diligence
Analyse quality of earnings and defensible adjustments
Assess net debt, debt-like items and a working-capital peg
Review cash generation and management forecasts
Translate DD findings into price and SPA implications
Report findings clearly and act with integrity

integrative_case: You lead buy-side financial due diligence on a mid-market manufacturer. Normalise EBITDA, identify debt-like items, set a working-capital peg, pressure-test the management forecast, and translate your findings into price and SPA implications in an executive summary for the deal committee.
